audit.why: EVEN at 5.5/10 matches 52.23% over 358 games: he wins the level 1-3 burst window, you win every stage from level 4 once your DPS and Miasma outlast his cooldowns. The packet levelChart (Brand, Skill, Skill, Cass x4) agrees with both layers already.

Your spikes: level 6 Petrifying Gaze (120s rank 1), Tear/Lost Chapter, Seraph's + Liandry's. His: level 3 Sear-into-Pillar burst and Pyroclasm at 6 (100s rank 1), both front-loaded and both on far longer cooldowns than your Twin Fang.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[1].why claimed Miasma's grounding removes 'the lane's mobility advantage'. Brand has no dash or movement ability in his kit, so grounding does nothing here — the slow is what matters. tradeBad also referenced 'the dash you were saving it for'.
audit.why: Brand's kit is Blaze, Sear, Pillar of Flame, Conflagration, Pyroclasm — no dash flag anywhere. The real interaction is that Sear only stuns a target already ablaze, so the dodge that matters is the Q after his W or E connects.
audit.corrected: Miasma's slow pins a dashless Brand in your fang range; Sear stuns only while Blaze is on you.

audit.why: Sear 8/7.5/7/6.5/6, Pillar of Flame 10/9.5/9/8.5/8, Pyroclasm 100/90/80 are the numbers that make the advice actionable.

edits.before: - Brand Sear (Stun): matchup-defining — Q only stuns when you are ablaze — after eating W or E, the stun line is the dodge that matters. Count it out loud if you must. - Your R Petrifying Gaze has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Sear: 8s at rank 1, 6s maxed — it only stuns while Blaze is on you, so the dodge that matters is the one right after his W or E lands. - Pillar of Flame is 10s at rank 1: step in as it resolves, not before. - Pyroclasm is 100s — his fight-winner costs what yours does.

edits.after: Miasma's slow, not its grounding, is what matters here: Brand owns no dash, so the cloud simply stops him walking out of your fangs.

edits.before: That is Brand’s rehearsed moment — don’t audition for it.

edits.after: A 120-second R spent escaping poke is the fight you lose later — hold it for his commit, then stun him face-on.

edits.before: Brand wins by landing Sear (Stun), denying your pattern, and keeping the fight at a distance your kit resents.
edits.after: Brand wins by stacking Blaze, stunning you with Sear, and detonating the passive before your poison has ticked once.

edits.before: Carry by DPS — no mid matches your damage-per-second from two items; your job is staying alive long enough to prove it.
edits.after: Carry by surviving one rotation: his burst is front-loaded and Pyroclasm is 100 seconds, so the fight after it belongs to you.
